steps.what: Capture merchandise or service details and confirm the charge basis
Compute and check charges for merchandise or services in the till
Receive payments, check the result and issue the transaction receipt

tasks.design: Configure tariff categories and clear charge breakdowns in the {OTHER} till or rental counter system. Retain transaction capture and payment handling; reduce only repeated tariff navigation and charge-checking effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff may navigate several tariff screens even when arithmetic is already automatic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tariff and receipt configuration can present the relevant charge basis together.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed fees, unusual service scope and payment exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk explains the amount and resolves discrepancies with the customer.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less screen navigation, with unchanged charging authority.

reach.task: Investigate a payment discrepancy against the receipt

evidence.claim: Configuring tariff presentation can reduce repeated navigation; the time split and saving are unmeasured model assumptions, not a claim that existing automatic arithmetic becomes new labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is counter-clerk transaction and payment effort. Existing till calculation runtime and customer payment time earn no labour saving.

Clerk s1 captures item or service ID, quantity, rental duration if applicable, tariff category and authorised adjustments. Capture retains all 35 hours; missing tariff data means manual resolution before charging.

Tariff administrator produces approved rate, tax, deposit and validity rules through ordinary existing tariff maintenance. No extra work is transferred; any additional support must be measured before rollout.
Test native tariff displays first. s2 savings apply only to repeated navigation, not arithmetic already performed by the till. s3 includes checking amount and tender before finalising payment.
research_questions: Does native charge presentation reduce clerk time after full transaction and payment checks?

incremental.description: Check display mappings after tariff changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact transaction ID, items, total, adjustments and tender checked before payment finalisation; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=35+24+35=94. Gross 6 less 1 upkeep is net 5. Low assumes the till already presents everything together; high requires the stated navigation friction. Capture and payment work do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Receive orders and clarify the requested services, dates and items
Record and confirm orders in the rental or service order system

tasks.design: Configure service-specific forms and reusable customer details in the {OTHER} rental or service-order system. The clerk still clarifies the request, captures its fields and checks the final order before committing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Generic forms can require repeated entry and navigation for familiar services.
tasks.enabler_now: Rental records and item availability are available in existing systems; native forms may fit the counter flow.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous repair requests and promises that need operational confirmation.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk hears what the customer needs and avoids promising an unsuitable service.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive form navigation; unchanged acceptance authority.

reach.task: Clarify an item identifier before a service order is accepted

evidence.claim: Booqable tracks item availability and rental history with barcode check-in. That supports rental record capability, not the savings assumed for all service types.
Native forms and reuse of checked customer fields may reduce repeated entry without removing request capture.

assumptions: Boundary is receiving and recording a counter order, not physical receipt, repair, charging or fulfilment.

Clerk produces clarified request in s1. In s2 the clerk captures customer ID or checked contact details, service code, item ID, dates, quantity, request notes and agreed conditions; capture, correction and approval remain within 28 hours.
No customer self-entry or pre-existing structured request is assumed. Existing checked customer fields are reused only after identity confirmation; otherwise entry remains manual.
Test native forms before custom development. Missing service codes, capacity or uncertain dates return to human clarification; the form does not infer acceptance.
research_questions: Can native forms reduce repeated entry while preserving complete requests and accurate commitments?

already_counted.description: Capture request fields, check and confirm the order

incremental.description: Maintain service-form defaults and field checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact order ID, customer, service, item, dates, quantity, notes and agreed conditions checked before commit; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=60+28=88. Gross 12 less 1 upkeep is net 11. Low covers already efficient forms or mainly novel requests; high requires repetitive form work and all capture fitting the retained 28 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain rental fees, policies and procedures

steps.what: Find the applicable rental fees, policies and procedures
Explain rental fees, policies and procedures and answer customer questions

tasks.design: Configure a category-indexed terms view in the {OTHER} rental system or {DOCS}. Show the exact current text and fee table; the clerk checks applicability and explains it without generated contractual advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant terms can be spread over separate pages.
tasks.enabler_now: A native indexed view can bring approved terms together.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining deposits, exceptions and disputed obligations clearly.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk checks understanding and escalates requests for exceptions.
tasks.altitude: Faster reference lookup while customer explanation time stays intact.

reach.task: Explain a deposit separately from the final rental charge

evidence.claim: An indexed approved-terms view can shorten reference lookup; no rental-specific measured saving is supplied by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is information explanation, not calculating a bill, accepting an order or changing terms.
Clerk s1 selects rental category and question topic and checks the extract. Selection and any manual search remain within its retained 15 hours; no structured question flag is supplied for free.

Policy owner produces approved terms with category, topic, effective date and version through existing maintenance. Additional tagging and checks are covered by clerk upkeep; no new owner effort is assumed.
Test native search and links before code. Missing, expired or conflicting terms require manual source checking; the system supplies no inferred answer.
research_questions: Does indexed lookup reduce search time without omitting exceptions from the explanation?

already_counted.description: Select applicable terms and resolve lookup exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain terms index and current-version links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=15+75=90. Gross 10 less 1 upkeep is net 9. Low assumes existing single-screen terms; high assumes a 25-hour fragmented lookup baseline. Customer explanation retains all 75 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify rental items, requested dates and the customer's information need
Check availability, operation guidance and description for the identified rental items
Provide item information and explain operation within the approved guidance

tasks.design: Link the {OTHER} rental availability view to approved item descriptions and operation instructions in the {DOCS}. The clerk confirms the item and dates, checks the returned information and explains it; the view makes no reservation or safety judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability and operating instructions may live in separate views.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing rental systems track item availability; item-linked guidance can remove repeated searching.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying an ambiguous item and knowing when a demonstration or specialist is needed.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk asks clarifying questions and checks the customer understands safe operation.
tasks.altitude: Less information retrieval, with unchanged customer advice responsibilities.

reach.task: Check a requested accessory against an item's approved compatibility list

evidence.claim: Booqable tracks availability and rental history per item and supports barcode check-in; this supports the availability lookup capability.
Linking item identifiers to approved operation instructions is a proposed deterministic design, with unmeasured savings.

assumptions: Boundary is providing information; physical demonstration, reservation and equipment condition checks remain separate work.
Clerk captures and checks item ID and requested dates in s1; all 25 hours stay. In s2 clerk selects the item and checks availability freshness and guidance version within retained 15 hours.

Ordinary counter staff produce reservations and returns; equipment staff produce condition blocks; document owner supplies approved item-ID/version instructions. Existing capture is unchanged, not counted as a saving. New link maintenance is included in upkeep.
Test native item pages and attachments first. Stale availability, missing guidance or uncertain item identity leads to manual checking or specialist referral rather than an invented answer.
research_questions: Does linked lookup reduce retrieval time while preserving correct availability and operation explanations?

already_counted.description: Check item identity, source freshness and lookup exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain item-to-guidance links and freshness checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=25+15+45=85. Gross 15 less 1 upkeep gives net 14. Low covers existing linked item pages or unreliable availability; high assumes 30 hours of separate searching reducible to 15. Clarification and explanation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated counter navigation while retaining customer conversations, payment handling and order acceptance.
reach: Check accessories against approved item data with a parts salesperson
skills_to_grow: Check source freshness and item identity
role.ambitious_version: Run a clearer counter information flow with checked current terms and item data, without delegating customer commitments.
